description: This file contains unit tests for the functions encodeSlackModalPrivateMetadata and parseSlackModalPrivateMetadata, which handle encoding and decoding Slack modal private metadata.

methods.name: parseSlackModalPrivateMetadata
methods.description: Parses a JSON string containing Slack modal private metadata into an object, returning empty object for invalid or missing data.

methods.name: encodeSlackModalPrivateMetadata
methods.description: Encodes an object containing Slack modal private metadata into a JSON string, omitting empty fields and throwing if payload exceeds Slack's size limit.
